name: io.github.macropulse-lab/irl-gateway
title: IRL Gateway
description: An AI agent's trading mandate it can't break: checked before every order, reasoning sealed in IRL.

environmentVariables.name: IRL_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the IRL server

environmentVariables.name: IRL_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The agent registered on IRL (its mandate)

environmentVariables.name: IRL_MODEL_HASH
environmentVariables.description: The model hash the agent was registered with (64 hex)

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_BROKER
environmentVariables.description: paper (default, live prices, no keys) or exchange
